description: Curated prompt-injection attack-phrase corpus for the L1 heuristic scorer. Seeded from Rebuff's open heuristic corpus (github.com/protectai/rebuff, MIT) and the PI-* regex patterns in filter-patterns.yaml. Plain data — update phrases here without code changes. Each phrase is matched by normalized Sørensen-Dice similarity against sliding windows of the input; see src/lib/heuristic-scorer.ts.
